name: Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe
author: Tangram Games (sound by potato-tan); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
license: MIT (code), CC BY 4.0 (graphics, text, sound and music) (game); MIT (emulator)
description: Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe, the remastered edition of Tangram Games' arcade platformer: bounce on enemies to climb as high as you can before time runs out. Runs in original Game Boy mode on the built-in emulator. Code MIT, assets CC BY 4.0 (github.com/SimonLarsen/tobutobugirl-dx).

descriptions.it: Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe, l'edizione rimasterizzata del platform arcade di Tangram Games: rimbalza sui nemici per salire il più in alto possibile prima che scada il tempo. Gira in modalità Game Boy originale sull'emulatore integrato. Codice MIT, grafica e musica CC BY 4.0 (github.com/SimonLarsen/tobutobugirl-dx).
